statements.text: AGENTA AS, with organization number 911814684, is a registered AS founded on 2013-03-01 and located in Trondheim.
The company's industry is classified under code 74.120 for graphic design and visual communication design.
The company's website reports that Agenta in Trondheim creates websites, webshops, AI agents, and integrations as a total supplier since 2013.
Revenue increased from 1,376,443 NOK in the period ending 2023-12-31 to 1,444,629 NOK for the period ending 2024-12-31, and further increased to 1,601,430 NOK for the period ending 2025-12-31.
Operating results changed from -87,300 NOK for the period ending 2023-12-31 to -74,525 NOK for the period ending 2024-12-31, and then changed to -169,022 NOK for the period ending 2025-12-31.
Silje Åstum Hildrum serves as the chief executive officer and board deputy member, while Kris Ingar Åstum Hildrum is the board chair.
